thread:
morgan: thinking out loud — want to propose a tiny wrapper around the deploy bot to standardize pin + preflight + release-note generation. keeps humans out of the repetitive bits.

tia: yes please. what would it do exactly?

morgan: three things: 1) enforce change windows (auto-block outside allowed hours), 2) auto-pin the manifest and annotate the release-note template, 3) run a lightweight smoke checklist and if failures, trigger an automated rollback candidate and notify oncall.

release-bot: /deploy v2.14.3 --pin=sha:abc123 --change-window=2026-03-25T14:00Z/2026-03-25T18:00Z --notes-template="release: {{version}}
summary: {{summary}}
rollout: {{rollout_plan}}"

morgan: that command is what the wrapper would emit, not what users type. users would call /release-gw start --version v2.14.3 --summary "cache fix" and gw would translate + run preflight.

devops: love it. how do we detect smoke failures? do we run existing checks or something new?

morgan: existing smoke scripts + a quick health-check endpoint call (3 tries, 2s backoff). if smoke fails, wrapper calls: /deploy rollback --to=previous --annotate="auto-rollback: smoke-fail" and posts a short incident annotation.

tia: need to be careful with auto-rollback for DB migrations. can we opt out per-release?

morgan: yes — add flag --no-auto-rollback for releases with schema changes. wrapper must parse manifest for migrations and set the flag automatically if migration detected.

devops: what about pin semantics? sometimes we want soft-pin (for canaries) vs hard pin (full rollback safety).

sandeep: suggestion: three modes: soft (tag only), hard (immutable pin on infra + annotation), and canary (soft pin + staged rollout policy). default to hard for prod, soft for staging.

morgan: sketch of the shim (pseudo):
```
# /bin/release-gw
parse args
if not in change_window: warn/abort
resolve_manifest(version) -> sha
if has_migrations(manifest) then set no_auto_rollback flag
emit deploy command to deploy-bot with appropriate flags
run smoke_checks() || trigger_rollback(sha_previous)
post release-note using template engine
```

tia: nice. storage for generated release notes? a small S3 prefix + console link would be great.

sandeep: also keep a simple state file in k8s configmap for in-progress releases so the console can show current status and provide abort/force-commit actions.

release-bot: note: added a quick action — `@release-bot abort` and `@release-bot force-commit` already supported by ops. wrapper should call those when needed.

morgan: next steps: I'll open a PR with a minimal CLI and a GH action that runs the smoke matrix. can we get a devops review?

devops: +1, can review. also propose an ops-runbook snippet for the special-case of long migrations.

tia: can you include a template for release notes with fields we discussed? i'll wire it into Console front-end once PR lands.

morgan: will do. quick MVP timeline: PR this week, lab demo next Tue, roll out to staging Wednesday.

sandeep: add a toggle in Console to disable auto-rollback per-team. ops will want control.

morgan: noted. thanks all :rocket:
